name: bmad-dev-tdd
description: Test-first replacement for the dev step of the BMad story cycle — per-behavior failure-mode analysis, then red-green-refactor, then defensive hardening justified by tests.

plugins.name: bmad-dev-tdd
plugins.description: Interactive test-first alternative to bmad-dev-story for one step of the cycle, not an unattended orchestrator: enumerate failure modes per behavior, derive a test list, run red-green-refactor, then harden defensively. Requires the bmm module.
